name: TC-187: a coupon stops applying and blocks Pay when the cart drops below its minimum order amount
description: A minOrderAmount coupon applies while two cart lines clear the minimum; removing one line re-quotes the cart, the server drops the discount with an ERROR issue on the code ('Your order doesn't meet the minimum for that coupon.'), and Pay is blocked until the code is removed.
